notes.title: The Wall Mustn't Fall 1.0 Released
notes.notes:
Took a while, but we're finally here.

Thanks to everyone who made suggestions and submitted bug reports. Without you guys, I have no idea what the entire process would have looked like.

So yeah, game's out. Maybe there will be some new players.

notes.title: Exiting early access on October 4th
notes.notes: The version that is currently in early access is almost identical to the 1.0 release, the changes are very minor. Wait a couple of days and save a dollar.

notes.title: 0.24.0 - Range change
notes.notes:
The biggest change this patch is the change to range. Most weapons received a range nerf because with only a few points of range, most weapons would be able to reach across the map, making the stat uninteresting. There has also been an enemy hp reduction to try and match the loss in player strength.

Mostly UI work, but a decent sized patch. Skipped to 0.2.0 because of the gameplay change with removing target priority.
